context: An elder banker mentors a younger CEO over coffee
purpose: Teach: 控除/アイディア/任意/幸運/配当/開業/相続/軌道

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: コーヒーでも飲みながら話そうか。会社を開業して三年、ようやく軌道に乗ってきたようだね。
lines.en: Let's talk over coffee. It's been three years since you started the company, and it finally seems to be on track.
lines.style: Warm mentor tone, slow paced, fatherly opening over coffee.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: おかげさまで。ただ、来期は株主配当をどう設計するかで悩んでいまして。
lines.en: Thanks to you. But I'm struggling with how to design the shareholder dividends next term.
lines.style: Respectful younger CEO, measured but slightly anxious delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 配当方針は経営者の哲学が出るところだ。慌てず、長期で考えなさい。
lines.en: Dividend policy is where a manager's philosophy shows. Don't rush — think long term.
lines.style: Calm authoritative advice, gently lecturing without condescension.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 実は新規事業のアイディアもあるんですが、初期投資が大きくて。所得控除をうまく使えないかと。
lines.en: Actually, I have an idea for a new business too, but the initial investment is huge. I was wondering if I could use income tax deductions well.
lines.style: Leaning forward, sharing strategy, business-minded younger voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 節税は大事だが、本質を見失うな。それと、お父様からの相続の件は片付いたのかい。
lines.en: Tax saving matters, but don't lose sight of the essence. By the way, has the matter of inheritance from your father been settled?
lines.style: Shifts to personal concern, lowered voice, paternal worry.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい、任意の遺言書があったおかげで、兄弟間で揉めずに済みました。本当に幸運でした。
lines.en: Yes, thanks to a voluntary will, we avoided disputes between siblings. I was truly lucky.
lines.style: Grateful, relieved tone, slight emotion creeping into voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: それは何よりだ。経営も家庭も、運を味方につけられる人間が最後に勝つものだよ。
lines.en: Nothing could be better. In both business and family, the one who can make luck his ally wins in the end.
lines.style: Reflective closing wisdom, warm smile audible in voice.
